items.title: Hollander POTD Fat Lever. Arizona St G was drafted 11th by POR in 82. Solid reserve for 2 yrs before trade to POR in 84 where he blew up (peaking at 19.8 ppg, 9.3 rpg, 7.9 apg in 88-89) & 2x all-star. Hurt knee in 90, & wasn't the same. One of the true underrated 80s greats.
